game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before goblin raiders exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
player_objective: Reach the royal seal using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
win_condition: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the royal seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Royal Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Royal Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 17.
